# Cncf Distr Reviewer

Review Distr using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Application Definition &amp; Image Build category. The Open Source control plane for self-managed, BYOC, and on-prem deployments. Everything you need to distribute applications to self-managed customers out of the box.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
